name: Self-contained 3D physics scene
prompt: Build ONE self-contained HTML file showing a real 3D physics scene that runs by itself: at least 15 balls dropping under gravity, bouncing off the floor and each other with energy loss, viewed through a lit, slowly orbiting camera. Use Three.js via a CDN <script> tag (the viewer has internet) or a hand-rolled 3D projection on canvas — your call. Requirements: a full-viewport <canvas>; the animation starts automatically via requestAnimationFrame with NO clicks needed; include one <button> labeled Reset that re-drops the balls; no console errors. Output only the html code fence.
notes: canvas_motion samples the canvas twice ~1.2s apart: the scene must ACTUALLY be animating (physics running by itself), not a static render.
